verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships an official, documented CLI. It installs via pipx or uv, offers `semgrep scan` and `semgrep ci` commands, exports machine-readable SARIF, supports `--dry-run` and `--autofix`, and needs no login, all of which suit scripted and agent-driven use. A community user independently reports feeding the CLI's SARIF output to LLMs for triage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent- or AI-oriented CLI usage patterns (e.g., JSON output for agents), plus one reported Windows pip install failure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: semgrep scan - This is the recommended command for scanning local codebases or scanning a project when you don't have a Semgrep account
